findings.location: source.html / translation.html, paragraph beginning “Jioni hiyo hasa”
findings.source_quote: “It looked like so much fun as they trotted around the pond and through the lawn.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “walipokuwa wakizunguka bwawa kwa mwendo wa kunyata” with “walipokuwa wakizunguka bwawa huku farasi wakikimbia kwa hatua fupi” to convey the horses’ trotting gait.
findings.translation_quote: “Ilionekana kufurahisha sana walipokuwa wakizunguka bwawa kwa mwendo wa kunyata na kupita kwenye nyasi.”
